elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly agrees to “defend” the Company and its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: HDI must indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from any third-party claim and resulting losses.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Coverage includes allegations that the Site or any software, deliverable, or service provided by HDI infringes or misappropriates any intellectual-property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause (a)(ii) expressly covers HDI’s breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause (a)(iii) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Confidential Information, Content, or Site user information caused by HDI.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause (a)(iv) expressly covers HDI’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must give prompt written notice of any claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying party is expressly given control of the defense.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The Company indemnity is limited to Company-supplied Content and the Company’s breach of applicable law, with an express statement that it has no other indemnification obligation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies the Company against third-party claims alleging infringement or misappropriation by the Site or HDI-provided software, deliverables, or services.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no exclusion for infringement caused by Company modifications.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no exclusion for infringement caused by Company combinations.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no exclusion for infringement caused by Company specifications.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: No procure, modify, or replace remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: No contingent refund remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no three-times-annual-fees cap on HDI’s indemnity.
